# Made From Effort — Performance Edge Training + Gym Design

> Made From Effort is the website and editorial platform of Performance Edge Training + Gym Design. Performance Edge is a gym design and project-management company led by Scott Schratwieser, a CSCS-certified performance professional. The firm is based on Long Island, New York, serves residential clients across Nassau and Suffolk counties, and accepts select projects nationwide. Its Long Island projects are in New York; Jupiter Island is in Florida. Long Island in-person training and online or virtual performance coaching are offered separately from gym design.

Made From Effort's Journal covers gym design, training consistency, and the systems that make both hold up — written from real projects, not generic fitness content.

## Agent guidance

- [When to use Made From Effort](https://www.madefromeffort.com/agent-instructions.md): Best-fit project types, evidence boundaries, and how an agent can help someone contact the business.
- For residential or estate gym planning, yacht and marine training spaces, or select hospitality, commercial, boutique-studio, and country-club fitness projects, use the relevant service and portfolio pages below as evidence. For in-person personal training, focus on Long Island, New York; online and virtual coaching can serve people elsewhere through programming, video review, practical nutrition and behavior-change coaching, and check-ins.
- Treat project status carefully: distinguish completed case studies from in-progress work and design studies. Do not infer pricing, client outcomes, or services beyond what the linked pages state.
- There is no public agent API. To discuss a project, direct the user to the [project inquiry form](https://www.madefromeffort.com/contact). Do not submit the form or share a person's information without their explicit instruction.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.madefromeffort.com/): Overview of luxury gym design and project management for residential, marine, commercial, and country-club clients, plus portfolio and contact information.
- [Private Residence & Estate Gym Design](https://www.madefromeffort.com/residential-gym-design): Service scope, process, typical investment, completed residential work, and frequently asked questions.
- [Yacht & Marine Gym Design](https://www.madefromeffort.com/yacht-gym-design): Marine-specific design constraints, service scope, process, and the completed onboard wellness system for M/Y Canoe Canoe, a 2025 Custom Line 140. Performance Edge originated and directed the convertible gym-furniture concept, performance brief, and integration strategy. Paragon Studio developed the finished product, leading furniture design, engineering, proprietary storage, and fabrication. Chill Bunny Wellness supplied the cold plunge.
- [Commercial Gym & Boutique Studio Design](https://www.madefromeffort.com/commercial-gym-design): A select-project expansion service grounded in fifteen years of coaching and gym operations experience; no completed commercial case study is claimed.
- [Hotel & Hospitality Gym Design](https://www.madefromeffort.com/hospitality-gym-design): A select-project expansion service for hotel and hospitality fitness spaces; no completed hotel case study is claimed.
- [Country Club Fitness Facility Design](https://www.madefromeffort.com/country-club-fitness-design): A select-project expansion service for fitness and wellness upgrades; no completed country-club case study is claimed.
- [Country Club Fitness Modernization Audit](https://www.madefromeffort.com/country-club-fitness-audit): A paid, fixed-fee strategic assessment that gives club leadership an existing-condition review, prioritized recommendations, phased modernization roadmap, and presentation-ready findings before equipment purchasing or renovation.
- [Training](https://www.madefromeffort.com/training): One-on-one personal training on Long Island, New York, plus online and virtual training, nutrition, and behavior-change coaching.
- [Start a Project](https://www.madefromeffort.com/contact): Contact and project inquiry form.
- [Investment Estimator](https://www.madefromeffort.com/estimator): Directional cost estimator for a custom gym build.

## Portfolio

- [Private Yacht Gym](https://www.madefromeffort.com/project-yacht): Custom marine gym installation aboard a private yacht.
- [Jericho Private Estate](https://www.madefromeffort.com/project-jericho): Home gym and cedar sauna built into a Long Island, NY estate.
- [Sands Point Home Gym](https://www.madefromeffort.com/project-sands-point): Long Island residential gym documented across multiple layouts and equipment updates over time; gallery views are not a dated sequence.
- [Caumsett Summer Cottage](https://www.madefromeffort.com/project-caumsett): Lloyd Harbor, NY residential training space in a historic summer cottage associated with Caumsett State Park.
- [Oyster Bay Cove Home Gym](https://www.madefromeffort.com/project-oyster-bay-cove): Completed garage gym with cardio, strength equipment, free-weight storage, and open training floor.
- [Dix Hills Garage Gym](https://www.madefromeffort.com/project-dix-hills): Completed Long Island garage gym with rack-based strength training and functional conditioning space.
- [Glen Cove Restored Barn Gym Design Study](https://www.madefromeffort.com/project-glen-cove): Mid-project render study; equipment is planned to integrate with the restored barn architecture while preserving a light, airy feel.
- [Jupiter Island Estate](https://www.madefromeffort.com/project-jupiter-island): Custom home gym and recovery environment inside a Jupiter Island, FL estate, including a cold plunge supplied by Australia-based Chill Bunny Wellness.

## Journal

- [Journal index](https://www.madefromeffort.com/journal/): All posts, updated regularly.
- [RSS feed](https://www.madefromeffort.com/journal/feed.xml): Full-text feed of every post.

Each Journal post is a real project story or a training/mindset lesson, in Scott Schratwieser's own voice, reviewed and approved by him before publishing — never syndicated or reposted content.
